meta.title: Knockout configuration: offer basis, starting price, tick size, time difference
gaps: No dedicated catalog assertion can compare the exact configured starting price, tick size, or time-difference values with saved event data.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: No dedicated catalog assertion can compare the exact configured starting price, tick size, or time-difference values with saved event data.

steps.note: Start the required eRFX flow because Knockout auctions are only reachable through RFQ-to-Auction conversion.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing the RFQ.
Create a single RFQ stage as the source event for conversion.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required line item for the RFQ.
Commit a valid schedule so the RFQ can be published.
Add a participant required for publication.
Publish the RFQ so it can be converted to an auction.
Confirm the RFQ reached a published project page.
Open the converted auction create screen where Knockout configuration is available.

args.goal: On the converted auction create screen, select the Knockout strategy, choose the offer basis Best Price, enter valid Starting Price, Tick Size (price difference), and Time Difference values, save or apply the configuration, and stop with the event screen visibly showing all four configured settings.

steps.note: Configure and visually verify the Knockout-specific settings that no dedicated catalog step can manipulate.
Assert that the final configuration screen still exposes the saved starting-price setting.
Assert that the final configuration screen still exposes the saved tick-size setting.
Assert that the final configuration screen still exposes the saved time-difference setting.
